title: Accessibility assurance overlay

any: a visible interaction, form, navigation path, status message, focus path, or responsive control changes

skill_calls.when: keyboard or observable accessibility behavior can be executed

nodes.obligation: Review semantics, labels, keyboard, focus, contrast, target size, status, motion, and narrow viewport behavior as applicable.

tests.evidence: automated findings and non-automatable keyboard/focus behavior are separately dispositioned
tests.command_source: target accessibility runner plus manual browser checks

workline_policy: Attach to design or frontend; split only when independent review ownership or a separate evidence batch is required.
omission_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE when no visible interaction, content, semantics, focus, keyboard, status, target, motion, or responsive behavior changes.
repair: Accessibility failure reopens the affected design or frontend state, not unrelated backend work.
